items.description: Add Canvas Container element to the style editor that works like a layout container but with width and height set to 'canvas' mode, filling the entire printable page area. Should appear in the Layout category alongside Column and Row containers with purple color theme for visual distinction.
stepsToVerify: Open Elements Panel in style editor and expand Layout category
Verify 'Canvas Container' appears with description 'Full-page container'
Drag Canvas Container onto the canvas
Verify element has purple theme (border and background)
Open Properties Panel and verify Width Mode shows 'Canvas'
Open Properties Panel and verify Height Mode shows 'Canvas'
Verify element fills the entire printable area (page minus margins)
Change page size (e.g., A4 to Letter) and verify container auto-resizes
Drag other elements into the Canvas Container and verify they become children
Export PDF and verify Canvas Container renders correctly
